proven_only: Bounded original x86 ld-linux early callee memory side effect under source-pinned FEX on an Android handset: guest ELF/AUXV, anonymous guest mmap/store/load/munmap, saved stack/register state and original RW byte AND; source byte restoration plus native W^X.

Wine/Proton, Windows PE loading, Vulkan/DXVK/VKD3D or game execution

Independent hardware/OS-level attestation of screenshot output
next_gate: Semantically integrate actual ELF dynamic relocation/TLS/guest FS-base dependency behind a new isolated Linux ARM64 real-FEX functional gate, then Android/Bionic cross-link, then upgrade the existing signed org.kernix.diagnostics package.
